items.title: Ölraffinerie in der russischen Region Samara von Drohnen attackiert
items.teaser: In der Nacht auf den Freitag, den 30. Oktober, haben Drohnen die Ölraffinerie Nowokuibyschewsk in der russischen Region Samara und eine Fabrik in der Region Brjansk, die Konserven und Einmannpackungen für die russische Armee herstellt, angegriffen, wie The Moscow Times berichtet.

items.title: Russian forces launch over 20 attacks on Dnipropetrovsk region overnight
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked four districts of the Dnipropetrovsk region with drones more than 20 times overnight.

items.title: Köpfe: LTO Most Wanted mit Wolfgang Kaleck
items.teaser: "Die Suche nach Gerechtigkeit wird zu einer niemals endenden Aufgabe, an die wir uns machen sollten", sagt Wolfgang Kaleck. Er blickt auf die Zukunft des Völkerrechts und verrät, was man von Edward Snowden lernen kann.

items.title: General Staff: Russia has lost 1,586,500 troops in Ukraine since Feb. 24, 2022
items.teaser: The number includes 1,590 casualties that Russian forces suffered over the past day.

items.title: Russland wird erstmals seit 2022 WM-Gastgeber in olympischer Sportart Gewichtheben
items.teaser: Die Gewichtheber-WM 2030 wird in Russland stattfinden. Während der Weltverband IWF die Vergabe nach Moskau verteidigt, kündigt die Ukraine Einsprüche gegen die Entscheidung an. Klare Kritik kommt vom deutschen Verband.

items.title: Russian airstrike on Izium: Bodies of four victims recovered from rubble
items.teaser: Rescuers have recovered the bodies of four people from the rubble of a building in Izium, Kharkiv region.

items.title: Luftwaffe wehrt drei russische Raketen und 96 Drohnen ab
items.teaser: Die ukrainischen Luftstreitkräfte haben ihren eigenen Angaben zufolge 3 Raketen und 96 Drohnen, mit denen Russland die Ukraine in der Nacht auf den 30. Oktober. angegriffen hat, abgewehrt.

items.title: War update: Over 200 clashes along front line as Russian forces attack in eight sectors
items.teaser: A total of 211 combat engagements were recorded along the front line on October 29. The heaviest fighting took place in the Kostiantynivka, Pokrovsk and Huliaipole sectors.

items.title: Russian strikes on Kyiv kill one, injure another, damage homes and businesses
items.teaser: One person was killed and another injured in Russian ballistic missile and drone attacks on Kyiv that began in the evening of October 29.

items.title: Russland greift Kyjiw mit ballistischen Raketen an: es gibt einen Toten
items.teaser: Russland hat am späten Abend ballistische Raketen auf Kyjiw abgefeuert.

items.title: Drones strike Russian oil refinery and military canning plant, media report
items.teaser: Overnight on October 30, a group of drones struck the Novokuybyshevsk Oil Refinery in Russia’s Samara region.

items.title: reflectiÖns on “Digital Empires”
items.teaser: The post reflectiÖns on “Digital Empires” appeared first on Völkerrechtsblog .

items.title: In Region Saporischschja 56 Ortschaften beschossen, zwei Zivilisten getötet, 23 verletzt
items.teaser: Am vergangenen Tag beschossen die russischen Besatzungstruppen 56 Ortschaften in der Region Saporischschja 792 Mal.

items.title: Air defenses down three missiles, 96 drones used by Russia to attack Ukraine overnight
items.teaser: Ukraine’s air defense forces neutralized three aerial missiles and 96 unmanned aerial vehicles used by Russian forces to attack the country overnight on October 30. Enemy strikes were recorded at 17 locations.

items.title: Russian oil refinery reportedly attacked amid renewed Ukrainian strikes on energy infrastructure
items.teaser: The reported attack is being called a ‘resumption of strikes’ on various monitoring channels, being the first after an unofficial pause on Ukraine’s campaign against oil refineries that began in mid-October.

items.title: Russia’s war casualty toll in Ukraine up by 1,590 over past day
items.teaser: The total combat losses of Russian troops in Ukraine from February 24, 2022, to October 30, 2026, amount to approximately 1,586,500 personnel, including 1,590 over the past 24 hours.

items.title: One person killed in overnight Russian attack on Kyiv – photos
items.teaser: Emergency services report damage to buildings and cars across several Kyiv districts after an overnight Russian attack.

items.title: Norwegian delegation sees rescue equipment damaged by Russian attacks in Ukraine
items.teaser: Ukraine showed to its Norwegian partners rescue equipment damaged and destroyed by Russian attacks and shared its experience of responding to strikes on energy facilities and dealing with their aftermath.

items.title: National Guard troops strike Russian Molniya-13 mothership drone over Donetsk region
items.teaser: Interceptor drone pilots from the Omega Special Operations Center of the National Guard of Ukraine detected and struck a Russian Molniya-13 mothership drone in the skies over the Donetsk region.

items.title: Drones attack oil refinery in Russia's Novokuibyshevsk – photos and videos
items.teaser: Videos shared by monitoring Telegram channels show a blaze at the Novokuibyshevsk oil refinery, which produces jet fuel as well as petrol and diesel.

items.title: Russian forces attack industrial facility in Kremenchuk district
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked an industrial facility in the Kremenchuk district, Poltava region.

items.title: Russia loses 1,590 soldiers and two aircraft over past day
items.teaser: Ukraine's General Staff has updated data on Russian losses: Russia lost 1,590 soldiers killed and wounded over the past day.

items.title: Russian attacks leave over 350,000 without power in Dnipro and surrounding area
items.teaser: More than 350,000 consumers in Dnipro and surrounding settlements have been left without electricity following Russian attacks.

items.title: Military takes control of everything: Flash explains how private air defense works
items.teaser: Private air defense is working effectively. Businesses are investing in infrastructure and electronic warfare networks, but the military is in charge of air defense operations.

items.title: Drone attack reportedly kills worker at Russian-occupied Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant
items.teaser: The plant has repeatedly faced threats to nuclear safety, including drone attacks, disruptions to external power supplies, and incidents affecting plant workers.

items.title: Intelligence data: How many Su-34 fighter-bombers has Russia lost, and how many remain in service?
items.teaser: Since the start of the full-scale war, 43 Russian Su-34 fighter-bombers have been destroyed, and another seven enemy aircraft of this type have been damaged.

items.title: Russian forces attack industrial facility in Poltava Oblast
items.teaser: A Russian attack on an industrial site in the Kremenchuk district was reported overnight, following warnings of a ballistic missile threat.

items.title: National Bank revises 2026 real GDP forecast downward
items.teaser: According to the National Bank’s updated forecast, Ukraine’s real gross domestic product (GDP) will contract by 0.4% in 2026.

items.title: Next UDCG meeting to take place in Brussels on Nov 17
items.teaser: The next meeting of the Ukraine Defense Contact Group will take place in Brussels on November 17.

items.title: Global Review concludes with a declaration on partnerships for trade and development
items.teaser: Marking the 20th anniversary of the Aid for Trade Initiative, WTO members adopted a declaration on 30 October repositioning the initiative as "Aid for Trade: partnerships for trade and development". The declaration was adopted at a meeting of the Committee on Trade and Development, which wrapped up the two-day 10th Glo

items.title: SBU detains driver suspected of directing Russian attacks on Kyiv' regions thermal power plants
items.teaser: The Security Service of Ukraine (SBU) counterintelligence officers have detained a logistics company driver in the Kyiv region suspected of helping direct Russian strikes on local energy facilities at the direction of Russia's Federal Security Service (FSB).

items.title: Russian night attacks kill 1 in Kyiv, leave 350,000 in Dnipro without power
items.teaser: In Kyiv, multiple Russian ballistic missiles struck just after 10 p.m. local time. According to Kyiv Mayor Vitali Klitschko, warehouse buildings in the city's Darnitsky district were struck, starting fires.

items.title: All Moscow airports shut amid drone attack on Russian capital
items.teaser: Russian authorities claim that 862 drones targeting Moscow and the surrounding oblast were destroyed between the evening and morning, while flights were disrupted across the capital's airports.

items.title: Aktuelles zum Krieg in der Ukraine
items.teaser: Seit Februar 2022 führt Russland einen Angriffskrieg gegen die Ukraine, die Kämpfe dauern an. Alle Entwicklungen und Ukraine-News im Liveticker.

items.title: Russia suffers record battlefield losses in October – General Staff
items.teaser: As of October 29, Russian forces have suffered 49,040 personnel losses in combat this month, the highest monthly figure since Russia launched its full-scale invasion of Ukraine.

items.title: An armored capsule instead of an open platform: Ukraine develops an evacuation module for the Murakha UGV
items.teaser: The capsule is equipped with a camera featuring day and night channels and two-way audio communication to monitor the person’s condition.

items.title: Russo-Ukrainian war, day 1709: Russian jet drone kills 14 on Dnipro railway platform beside a Zaporizhzhia-bound train
items.teaser: Ukraine’s Navy says Neptune missiles destroyed two Su-34 bombers, Kyiv says Russia’s October losses already set a monthly record, and the Oleshky humanitarian mission moved forward after demining, while ISW warned Moscow may use the truce to rebuild its forces.

items.title: Over 350,000 consumers left without power after Russian attacks on Dnipro and nearby settlements
items.teaser: More than 350,000 electricity consumers in Dnipro and nearby settlements have lost power following Russian attacks.

items.title: Seven Russian tankers shipping diesel to US identified, located
items.teaser: A live tracker map developed by Greenpeace, an international environmental organization, shows Russian tankers currently moving across the Atlantic Ocean, with one vessel approaching the U.S. East Coast.

items.title: Five more Ukrainians evacuated from temporarily occupied territories – Lubinets
items.teaser: Five more Ukrainian citizens have been evacuated from temporarily occupied territories.

items.title: Steinmeier urges China to use its influence on Russia to end war against Ukraine
items.teaser: German Federal President Frank-Walter Steinmeier has called on China to use its influence over Russia to secure an end to Russian attacks on Ukraine and the start of serious peace negotiations.

items.title: Classrooms in Sumy Oblast are moving underground due to Russian shelling: 13 such schools are already operating, nine are under construction, and another 14 are at the design stage
items.teaser: Russian attacks have damaged 165 schools in Sumy Oblast since the start of the full-scale invasion.

items.title: Over 460 flights delayed or canceled in Moscow, St. Petersburg amid drone attack – media
items.teaser: More than 460 flights were delayed or canceled at airports in Moscow and St. Petersburg, Russia, on Thursday amid a drone attack.

items.title: EU sanctions against ISIL/Da’esh and Al-Qaeda: Council renews regime until 2027
items.teaser: The Council extended restrictive measures against individuals and groups associated with ISIL/Da'esh and Al-Qaeda for a further year, until 31 October 2027.

items.title: “The enemy has changed tactics”: Zaporizhzhia faces record number of Russian FPV drone attacks, hitting public transport 3 times in one day
items.teaser: The attacks injured 14 people, including a 14-year-old boy, and damaged residential buildings, warehouses, and vehicles.

items.title: Routes to Oleshky cleared of mines, humanitarian convoy ready to depart – Lubinets
items.teaser: Preparations for the humanitarian mission to Oleshky are nearing completion: the designated routes have been cleared of mines, and the humanitarian convoy has been assembled and is ready to depart.

items.title: Zelensky: Russian strikes killed 19 people in Dnipro, Chernihiv, Kremenchuk
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has said that Russian strikes on October 29 killed 19 people in Dnipro, Kremenchuk and Chernihiv.

items.title: Ukrainian Neptune strike destroys two Russian Su-34 bombers used to attack frontline cities, Ukraine’s Navy says
items.teaser: The aircraft are a key part of Russia’s tactical aviation fleet, used to launch guided aerial bombs against Ukrainian military positions and settlements near the front line.

items.title: Zelensky: Intelligence reports Russia preparing new ballistic missile strikes
items.teaser: Ukrainian intelligence has information indicating that Russia is preparing new ballistic missile strikes against Ukraine.

items.title: Ukraine war latest: 'Russia's mass murder' — Deadly Russian strikes on Dnipro, Chernihiv, Kremenchuk
items.teaser: Key developments on Oct. 28: 'Russia's mass murder:' Drone strike on Dnipro station kills 14 amid deadly daytime attacks on Chernihiv, Kremenchuk Ukraine destroys 2 Russian Su-34 bomber jets in Neptune missile strike on airfield, Navy says Route demining completed in Russian-occupied Oleshky as humanitarian convoy

items.title: Route demining completed in Russian-occupied Oleshky as humanitarian convoy prepares to enter, Ukraine's ombudsman says
items.teaser: The convoy is expected to arrive at the city's central hospital, where humanitarian assistance will be provided to residents, Lubinets said.

items.title: Polen übergibt zwei weitere MiG -29- Kampfjets an Ukraine
items.teaser: Polen wird in nächster Zeit zwei weitere MiG-29-Kampfjets im Rahmen eines neuen militärischen Hilfspakets im Wert von rund 50 Millionen Euro an die Ukraine übergeben. Die Militärhilfe umfasst auch Munition und Luftverteidigungssysteme.

items.title: Russian attack on humanitarian mission bus in Zaporizhzhia region kills woman, injures three
items.teaser: A woman was killed and three passengers were injured when a Russian drone struck a bus in the village of Bilenke in the Zaporizhzhia region. Other passengers also sustained trauma.

items.title: Meet Zakon: Ukraine creates its own national font to replace Russian type in state documents
items.teaser: The antiqua typeface draws upon the works of Ukraine's 20th century artists amid a decolonization push

items.title: NATO fears Trump will not supply interceptors to Ukraine before US elections – Euronews
items.teaser: Western partners express growing doubts over whether the White House will approve crucial air defence missiles for Kyiv ahead of next week's congressional vote.

items.title: Admiral Bauer: If Russia attacks, Alliance will fight back to break enemy
items.teaser: NATO is learning lessons from Ukraine's resistance to Russian aggression, but would likely repel a potential invasion differently, as the Alliance has far greater resources at its disposal – resources that Ukraine was denied from the very beginning of Russia's full-scale invasion.

items.title: Russische Drohne attackiert Bus einer humanitären Mission in Region Saporischschja: es gibt eine Tote und drei Verletzte
items.teaser: Am Donnerstag, den 29. Oktober, hat eine russische "First Person View"-Drohne (FPV) einen Sozialbus der humanitären Mission „Prolissok“ im Dorf Bilenke in der Region Saporischschja getroffen, teilt der Leiter der Organisation, Jewhen Kaplin, auf Facebook mit.

items.title: Demining complete, humanitarian convoy ready: Oleshky mission advances as ceasefire holds and Lubinets heads to occupied city
items.teaser: Ukrainian, Russian, and US delegations are coordinating a humanitarian operation in occupied Oleshky after mine clearance along designated routes. The mission aims to bring aid to civilians and facilitate their safe departure.

items.title: Why did Russia agree to the Oleshky ceasefire?
items.teaser: Moscow's consent to a temporary ceasefire in Russian-occupied Oleshky seems like a long-overdue and welcome concession from a country that has repeatedly rejected or violated ceasefire proposals during the full-scale invasion of Ukraine. So why is the Kremlin so on board with Oleshky ? Experts, as well as information

items.title: Zelenskyy: Russians planning further ballistic missile strikes
items.teaser: Ukraine's president has stated that intelligence indicates Moscow is planning fresh strikes, urging partners to provide air defence capabilities.

items.title: Urteil in Jenaer Prozess gegen IS-Terroristen
items.teaser: Am Oberlandesgericht Jena war ein 66-jähriger Iraker angeklagt, der sich 2014 dem "Islamischen Staat" angeschlossen haben soll. Danach tauchte er ab und lebte in Nordhausen. Am Donnerstag wurde das Urteil gesprochen.

items.title: Russian forces strike student dormitory in Dnipro, two teenage girls injured
items.teaser: The Russian army has struck a vocational school dormitory in Dnipro, sparking a fire.

items.title: Private air defence robotic turrets have destroyed over 60 targets
items.teaser: Brave1 reports that robotic systems deployed by non-state anti-aircraft brigades have successfully shot down dozens of threats, including missiles and drones.

items.title: Putin says Finnish and Norwegian leaders "did the right thing" by calling him
items.teaser: The Kremlin leader has said Moscow is prepared for a conflict with Europe but would prefer to avoid it, welcoming dialogue with Nordic nations.

items.title: Russische Gleitbombe trifft Mehrfamilienhaus in Isjum: mindestens 13 Menschen verletzt
items.teaser: Die russische Armee hat erneut die Stadt Isjum in der Region Charkiw angegriffen - es gibt Verletzte, teilt der Leiter der regionalen Militärverwaltung, Oleg Synehubow, auf Telegram mit.

items.title: Ukrainian, US, Russian representatives arrive at site from which aid will be delivered to Oleshky
items.teaser: Representatives of Ukraine, the United States and the Russian Federation have arrived at the site from which aid will be delivered to the temporarily occupied city of Oleshky in the Kherson region.

items.title: Human rights commissioner: routes demined, people wishing to leave Oleshky have until 14:00 to do so
items.teaser: The clearing of safe passages has concluded in the Russian-occupied town of Oleshky, Kherson Oblast, with residents permitted to leave the area until 14:00.

items.title: UN appoints Russian diplomat to oversee mine action, as Ukraine clears over 300,000 explosives in Kherson Oblast
items.teaser: "Moscow has mined the United Nations," Ukrainian Foreign Ministry spokesperson Heorhii Tykhyi wrote on X on Oct. 29, criticizing the decision.

items.title: Ukraine strikes Russian airfield with Neptune missiles, two Su-34s destroyed
items.teaser: The Ukrainian Navy has destroyed two Russian Su-34 fighter-bombers at the Marinovka airfield in Russia's Volgograd region.

items.title: Ukraine zerstört zwei Su - 34 Jagdbomber auf Militärflugplatz in Russland
items.teaser: Die ukrainische Marine hat zwei Su-34 - Jagdbomber auf dem Flugplatz „Marinowka“ in der russischen Region Wolgograd mit einer Neptun- Rakete zerstört.

items.title: Six lanes and metro line under fire: Kyiv prepares about $22 million for backup river crossings after Russian strike on Southern Bridge
items.teaser: The bridges are of critical importance. About 600,000 vehicles cross the Dnipro River in Kyiv every day.

items.title: Ukraine should not agree to limits on size of its armed forces – Admiral Bauer
items.teaser: There are two elements in the negotiation process that must be reliably secured before Ukraine should agree to any proposed peace settlement, according to Admiral Rob Bauer, former Chair of the NATO Military Committee.

items.title: Dnipro railway station strike: EU's chief diplomat urges greater efforts to hold Russia accountable
items.teaser: The EU's top diplomat has condemned the Russian strike on a railway station in Ukraine, calling for those responsible to be brought to justice via the Special Tribunal.

items.title: Russian drone strikes student accommodation in Dnipro
items.teaser: An attack by a Russian drone on a vocational college building has caused a fire on the upper floors, leaving two teenage girls requiring medical assistance.
